}

function totalBlocks(h) {
  return (h.messages || []).reduce((n, m) => n + (m.blocks?.length || 0), 0);
}

/* ===========================
   Harvest v0.3: schema + logic
   =========================== */
/**
 * HarvestV03 = {
 *   meta: { title, url, exported_at, model?, locale? },
 *   messages: [
 *     { index, id, role, timestamp?, hash,
 *       plain: { text, md },
 *       html, blocks: Block[], segments: Segment[] }
 *   ],
 *   pairs?: Array<{ userIndex, assistantIndex }>
 * }
 */

async function harvestConversationV03() {
  const messageEls = selectMessageElements();

  const messages = [];
  let i = 0;
  for (const el of messageEls) {
    messages.push(await normalizeMessageV03(el, i++));
  }

  const meta = {
    title: safeTitle(document.title.replace(/\s*\|\s*ChatGPT.*/i, '') || 'ChatGPT Conversation'),
    url: location.href,
    exported_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    model: detectModel(),
    locale: document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang') || undefined
  };

  const pairs = buildPairs(messages);

  return { meta, messages, pairs };
}

/* ===========================
   Message selection & parsing
   =========================== */
function selectMessageElements() {
  const selectors = [
    '[data-testid="conversation-turn"]',
    '[data-message-author-role]',
    'main article',
    'article',
    'div[role="article"]'
  ];
  const seen = new Set();
  const out = [];
  for (const sel of selectors) {
    document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el => {
      if (seen.has(el)) return;
      const text = (el.textContent || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      seen.add(el);
      out.push(el);
    });
  }
  return out;
}

async function normalizeMessageV03(el, index) {
  const role = detectRole(el);
  const id = el.getAttribute('id') || el.dataset.messageId || `msg-${index+1}`;
  const timestamp = detectTimestamp(el);

  // 1) Find rich content node & clone it
  const contentNode = findContentNode(el);
  const clone = contentNode.cloneNode(true);

  // 2) Sanitize UI chrome / non-content
  sanitizeClone(clone);

  // 3) Segments (back-compat) + HTML snapshot + plain text
  const segments = extractSegments(clone);
  const html = clone.innerHTML;
  const text = clone.innerText || '';
  const mdText = toMarkdownBlocks(clone); // block-aware MD

  // 4) Chunk into blocks for UI toggling
  const blocks = extractBlocks(clone);

  // 5) Hash for de-dupe (based on role + text + html)
  const hash = hashString([role, text, html].join('\n#'));

  return {
    index, id, role, timestamp, hash,
    plain: { text, md: mdText },
    html, blocks, segments
  };
}

function findContentNode(el) {
  return el.querySelector('[data-testid="markdown"], .markdown, .prose, .whitespace-pre-wrap, article, div') || el;
}

/* ===========================
   Sanitizer
   =========================== */
function sanitizeClone(root) {
  // Remove obvious UI chrome / controls / citations / avatars / toolbars
  const DROP = [
    'button',
    '[role="toolbar"]',
    '[data-testid="webpage-citation-pill"]',
    '[data-testid="citation-chip"]',
    '[data-testid="source-chip"]',
    '[data-testid="inline-toolbar"]',
    'svg[aria-hidden="true"]',
    'nav', 'aside'
  ];
  root.querySelectorAll(DROP.join(',')).forEach(n => n.remove());

  // Strip non-content attributes that might bloat HTML snapshots
  root.querySelectorAll('[class]').forEach(n => n.removeAttribute('class'));
  root.querySelectorAll('[style]').forEach(n => n.removeAttribute('style'));

  // Normalize links: keep href, drop target/rel/onclick
  root.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
    const href = a.getAttribute('href') || '';
    [...a.attributes].forEach(attr => {
      if (!/^(href|title|name|id|data-.*)$/.test(attr.name)) a.removeAttribute(attr.name);
    });
    if (href && !href.startsWith('#')) a.setAttribute('href', href);
  });

  // Remove empty nodes
  Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('*')).forEach(n => {
    if (!n.firstChild && !/^(img|br|hr|input|source)$/.test(n.tagName.toLowerCase())) {
      const text = (n.textContent || '').trim();
      if (!text) n.remove();
    }
  });
}

/* ===========================
   Segments (back-compat)
   =========================== */
function extractSegments(root) {
  const segments = [];

  // code
  root.querySelectorAll('pre code').forEach(code => {
    segments.push({
      type: 'code',
      language: (code.className || '').match(/language-([a-z0-9+#-]+)/i)?.[1] || '',
      text: code.innerText
    });
  });

  // images
  root.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(img => {
    segments.push({
      type: 'image',
      alt: img.getAttribute('alt') || '',
      src: img.getAttribute('src') || ''
    });
  });

  // tables
  root.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(tbl => {
    segments.push({ type: 'table', html: tbl.outerHTML });
  });

  // math (best effort)
  root.querySelectorAll('.katex, .math, .katex-mathml').forEach(m => {
    const latex = (m.textContent || '').trim();
    if (latex) segments.push({ type: 'math', latex });
  });

  // residual text as MD (for convenience)
  const md = toMarkdownBlocks(root);
  if (md.trim()) segments.unshift({ type: 'text', md });
  return segments;
}

/* ===========================
   Blocks (for UI toggling)
   =========================== */
function extractBlocks(root) {
  const blocks = [];
  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT, null);

  function pushParaFrom(el) {
    const md = toMarkdownInline(el).trim();
    if (md) blocks.push({ kind: 'para', md });
  }

  while (walker.nextNode()) {
    const n = walker.currentNode;
    if (!(n instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;

    // Skip if nested inside a block we've already handled
    if (n.closest('[data-block-consumed="1"]')) continue;

    const tag = n.tagName;

    // Headings
    if (/^H[1-6]$/.test(tag)) {
      n.setAttribute('data-block-consumed', '1');
      const level = Number(tag[1]);
      const text = (n.innerText || '').trim();
      blocks.push({ kind: 'heading', level, text });
      continue;
    }

    // Code block
    if (tag === 'PRE' && n.querySelector('code')) {
      n.setAttribute('data-block-consumed', '1');
      const code = n.querySelector('code');
      const language = (code?.className || '').match(/language-([a-z0-9+#-]+)/i)?.[1] || '';
      const text = code?.innerText || n.innerText || '';
      blocks.push({ kind: 'code', language, text });
      continue;
    }

    // Table
    if (tag === 'TABLE') {
      n.setAttribute('data-block-consumed', '1');
      blocks.push({ kind: 'table', html: n.outerHTML });
      continue;
    }

    // Image
    if (tag === 'IMG') {
      n.setAttribute('data-block-consumed', '1');
      blocks.push({ kind: 'image', alt: n.getAttribute('alt') || '', src: n.getAttribute('src') || '' });
      continue;
    }

    // Quote
    if (tag === 'BLOCKQUOTE') {
      n.setAttribute('data-block-consumed', '1');
      const md = toMarkdownInline(n).trim();
      if (md) blocks.push({ kind: 'quote', md });
      continue;
    }

    // Divider
    if (tag === 'HR') {
      n.setAttribute('data-block-consumed', '1');
      blocks.push({ kind: 'divider' });
      continue;
    }

    // Lists (UL/OL)
    if (tag === 'UL' || tag === 'OL') {
      n.setAttribute('data-block-consumed', '1');
      const ordered = tag === 'OL';
      const items = [];
      n.querySelectorAll(':scope > li').forEach(li => {
        const liClone = li.cloneNode(true);
        liClone.querySelectorAll('ul,ol').forEach(x => x.remove());
        const item = toMarkdownInline(liClone).trim();
        if (item) items.push(item);
      });
      if (items.length) blocks.push({ kind: 'list', ordered, items });
      continue;
    }

    // Paragraph-ish containers
    if (tag === 'P' || (tag === 'DIV' && hasMeaningfulText(n) && !containsBlockChildren(n))) {
      n.setAttribute('data-block-consumed', '1');
      pushParaFrom(n);
      continue;
    }
  }

  // Cleanup temp attribute
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-block-consumed]').forEach(e => e.removeAttribute('data-block-consumed'));
  return blocks;
}

function hasMeaningfulText(el) {
  const t = (el.innerText || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return t.length > 0;
}
function containsBlockChildren(el) {
  return !!el.querySelector('pre, table, img, blockquote, ul, ol, hr, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6');
}

/* ===========================
   Markdown helpers
   =========================== */
function toMarkdownBlocks(root) {
  const work = root.cloneNode(true);

  // Convert code blocks
  work.querySelectorAll('pre').forEach(pre => {
    const code = pre.querySelector('code');
    const lang = (code?.className || '').match(/language-([a-z0-9+#-]+)/i)?.[1] || '';
    const text = code?.innerText || pre.innerText || '';
    const fence = '```';
    const md = `\n\n${fence}${lang}\n${text}\n${fence}\n\n`;
    pre.replaceWith(textNode(md));
  });

  // Headings
  work.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6').forEach(h => {
    const level = Number(h.tagName[1]);
    const txt = (h.innerText || '').trim();
    const md = `\n\n${'#'.repeat(level)} ${txt}\n\n`;
    h.replaceWith(textNode(md));
  });

  // Lists
  work.querySelectorAll('ul,ol').forEach(list => {
    const ordered = list.tagName === 'OL';
    const items = [];
    list.querySelectorAll(':scope > li').forEach(li => {
      const t = toMarkdownInline(li).trim();
      items.push((ordered ? '1. ' : '- ') + t);
    });
    const md = `\n${items.join('\n')}\n\n`;
    list.replaceWith(textNode(md));
  });

  // Blockquotes
  work.querySelectorAll('blockquote').forEach(bq => {
    const md = toMarkdownInline(bq).split('\n').map(line => `> ${line}`).join('\n');
    bq.replaceWith(textNode(`\n${md}\n\n`));
  });

  // Images
  work.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(img => {
    const alt = img.getAttribute('alt') || 'image';
    const src = img.getAttribute('src') || '';
    img.replaceWith(textNode(`\n\n![${alt}](${src})\n\n`));
  });

  // Tables: keep as HTML
  const md = toMarkdownInline(work).trim();
  return md ? md + '\n' : '';
}

function toMarkdownInline(node) {
  let md = '';
  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(node, NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT | NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
  const stack = [];

  function open(tag, el) {
    if (tag === 'EM' || tag === 'I') { md += '*'; stack.push('*'); return; }
    if (tag === 'STRONG' || tag === 'B') { md += '**'; stack.push('**'); return; }
    if (tag === 'CODE' && el.parentElement?.tagName !== 'PRE') { md += '`'; stack.push('`'); return; }
    if (tag === 'A') { md += '['; stack.push({ type:'a', href: el.getAttribute('href') || '' }); return; }
    if (tag === 'BR') { md += '  \n'; return; }
  }
  function close(tag, el) {
    const last = stack.pop();
    if (last === '*' || last === '**' || last === '`') { md += last; return; }
    if (last && last.type === 'a') { md += `](${last.href})`; return; }
  }

  // We’ll simulate open/close by tracking depth with a simple stack based on entering/leaving nodes.
  // Since TreeWalker doesn’t give us explicit exit events, we’ll do a two-pass fallback:
  const nodes = [];
  (function collect(n) {
    nodes.push(n);
    for (let c = n.firstChild; c; c = c.nextSibling) collect(c);
  })(node);

  for (const n of nodes) {
    if (n.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
      md += (n.nodeValue || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      continue;
    }
    if (!(n instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
    open(n.tagName, n);
  }
  // Close any dangling tokens
  while (stack.length) {
    const last = stack.pop();
    if (typeof last === 'string') md += last;
    else if (last && last.type === 'a') md += `](${last.href})`;
  }

  md = md.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
  return md;
}

function textNode(s) { return document.createTextNode(s); }

/* ===========================
   Role, timestamp, model, hash, title
   =========================== */
function detectRole(el) {
  const attr = el.getAttribute('data-message-author-role') ||
               el.querySelector('[data-message-author-role]')?.getAttribute('data-message-author-role');
  if (attr) return attr;
  const aria = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (/assistant|gpt/.test(aria)) return 'assistant';
  if (/you|user/.test(aria)) return 'user';
  const text = el.textContent?.trim().slice(0, 80).toLowerCase() || '';
  if (text.startsWith('you:')) return 'user';
  return 'assistant';
}
function detectTimestamp(el) {
  const t = el.querySelector('time')?.getAttribute('datetime') ||
            el.querySelector('time')?.getAttribute('title') ||
            el.querySelector('time')?.textContent;
  if (!t) return null;
  const iso = new Date(t);
  return isNaN(iso.getTime()) ? (t || null) : iso.toISOString();
}
// Best-effort model sniff (header, menus, tooltips—very heuristic)
function detectModel() {
  const candidates = [
    '[data-testid="model-switcher"]',
    '[aria-label*="model"]',
    'header [role="button"][aria-haspopup="menu"]',
    'header'
  ];
  for (const sel of candidates) {
    const el = document.querySelector(sel);
    const txt = (el?.innerText || el?.getAttribute?.('aria-label') || '').trim();
    if (txt && /gpt|o\d|4\.?o|mini|pro|sonnet|flash/i.test(txt)) return txt;
  }
  const hdr = document.querySelector('header');
  if (hdr) {
    const txt = (hdr.innerText || '').trim();
    const m = txt.match(/(GPT[\w.-]+|o\d[\w.-]*)/i);
    if (m) return m[1];
  }
  return undefined;
}
function hashString(s) {
  let h = 5381;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) + h) + s.charCodeAt(i);
  return (h >>> 0).toString(16);
}
function safeTitle(t) {
  // Keep letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, dashes; collapse whitespace
  return (t || '')
    .replace(/[^\w\- ]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

/* ===========================
   Q/A Pairs
   =========================== */
function buildPairs(messages) {
  const pairs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < messages.length; i++) {
    if (messages[i].role === 'user') {
      let j = i + 1;
      while (j < messages.length && messages[j].role !== 'assistant') j++;
      pairs.push({ userIndex: i, assistantIndex: j < messages.length ? j : null });
    }
  }
  return pairs;
}

/* ===========================
   SPA nav watch + init
   =========================== */
(function watchRoute() {
  let lastHref = location.href;
  const handleNav = () => {
    if (location.href !== lastHref) {
      lastHref = location.href;
      if (CFG.urlGuard.test(location.href)) {
        mountOverlay(); recomputePosition();
      } else {
        unmountOverlay();
      }
    }
  };
  const _push = history.pushState;
  const _replace = history.replaceState;
  history.pushState = function(...args) { const r = _push.apply(this, args); handleNav(); return r; };
  history.replaceState = function(...args) { const r = _replace.apply(this, args); handleNav(); return r; };
  window.addEventListener('popstate', handleNav);
  setInterval(handleNav, 500);
})();

(function init() { if (CFG.urlGuard.test(location.href)) mountOverlay(); })();
